ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 35:65 ratio of high-intensity white to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central lobes exhibit large contiguous white regions; heavy black mottling and irregular speckling concentrated along the trailing edges and terminal tips; peduncle area is solid low-intensity black.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with an approximate 40-degree interior angle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) visible along the entire trailing edge of both lobes; highest density of pixel-level irregularity at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge leading to tapered, slightly recurved lobe tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast white clusters present on the far distal tip of the right lobe and scattered along the trailing edge of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular pixel boundary and white scarring at the right lobe tip, consistent with past trauma or heavy parasitic attachment.
